test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Beneath
solution: The correct answer is **'Above'**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Beneath**__**: In, at, or to a lower position than somebody/something; under (किसी अन्‍य के नीचे, तले, नीचे की ओर)** __ • **​E.g.__**- The ship disappeared **beneath** the waves. • **__Above__: In a higher place (उच्‍चतर स्‍थान में; ऊपर)** __ • **​E.g.__**- The people in the flat **above** make a lot of noise. ​Hence, the correct answer is **'Above'**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** __ • **Below**__**: At or to a lower position or level than somebody/something (किसी वस्‍तु या व्‍यक्ति से नीचे या निचले स्‍तर पर)** __ • **​E.g.__**- The temperature fell **below** freezing during the night. • __**Beyond**__**: On or to the other side of (की दूसरी ओर, के परे)** __ • **​E.g.__**- In the distance, **beyond** the river, was a small town. • ​__**Under**__**: In or to a position that is below something {(किसी के) नीचे, नीचे से}** __ • **​E.g.__**- We found him hiding **under** the table. 255:T8a5, The correct answer is **'No substitution required'.**
